newsitem.title: USA: Helisys sees greater FY96 loss than Street.
newsitem.headline: Helisys sees greater FY96 loss than Street.

text.p: Helisys Inc said on Friday its fiscal year 1996 earnings would show a greater loss than analysts were estimating, due to higher sales, general and administrative expenses.

"Although we do not know the specific results of our fourth quarter, it now appears that Helisys will experience a greater loss than previously expected for year-end," said Michael Feygin, chairman and chief executive officer.
Helisys said it also expected its fourth quarter earnings would also show a loss.
There was no First Call mean estimate for the company's fourth quarter or full year.
Feygin said: "The fact that we may experience a greater than expected loss results primarily from increased expense associated with actions taken to build long term shareholder value."
Helisys develops and builds automated systems for creating physical models, industrial patterns and product prototypes directly from three-dimensional computer generated designs.
